pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark, irregularly shaped polygonal regions with high edge angularity and sharp pixel-level gradients. The perimeter of individual patches is jagged and fractal-like.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-toned pathways separating the patches. Junction nodes typically consist of tri-radiate intersections. Pixel thickness of the corridors is relatively uniform across the flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible mane along the neck and shoulder presents a distinct jagged 1D silhouette with high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small, dark avian organism (likely Buphagus sp.) perched on the upper shoulder, creating a localized disruption in the dorsal silhouette.
